# PM Occupational Exposure Model

This model is intended to determine PM~2.5~ dose for workers based on specified input parameters

> This model is in development and should not be relied upon for exposure determinations.


## Inputs

- Daily work hours (start and stop time)
- Activity levels:
  - Proportion of resting, low, moderate, and high at work
  - Proportion of resting, low, moderate, and high away from work
- Respirators
  - Respirator use as % of work day
  - Respirator type
  - Fit testing (true/false)
  - Required use concentrations
  - Percent of population/time respirators are used voluntarily
- Engineering Controls
  - Buildings (home, commercial building)
  - Air filtration
    - Filter efficiency
    - Circulation rate
    - Room size ft^3^
- PM~2.5~ (in μg/m^3^) concentration in the area
  - Initially set single average daily PM~2.5~
  - Later, connect with historical hourly PM~2.5~ measurements

## Outputs

- Total daily PM~2.5~ dose
- Work PM~2.5~ dose
- Increased dose due to work
- Decreased dose due to PPE
- Decreased dose due to engineering controls

## Design

- Initially input parameters through the R script
- Once the model is set, create a Shiny app
